'''Annalisa Pastore''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|MAE}} is a Professor of [[Chemistry]] and [[Molecular Biology]] at [[King's College London]].<ref name=gs>{{Google scholar id}}</ref><ref name=scopus>{{Scopus id}}</ref> In 2018, she was appointed full professor at the [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa]].<ref name=superiore/> In 2022, she was appointed director of research for life sciences, chemistry and soft matter science at [[European Synchrotron Radiation Facility]]. She resigned in Frebruary 2023.<ref name=esrf>{{Cite web | url=https://www.esrf.fr/home/news/general/content-news/general/esrf-appoints-two-new-directors-of-research.html | title=ESRF appoints two new Directors of Research | date=2022-01-02 | access-date=2022-01-04 |  language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Education ==
Pastore studied chemistry at the [[University of Naples Federico II]]. She earned a master's degree in 1981 and her [[PhD]] in 1987.{{citation needed|date=November 2018}} She worked as an exchange student with [[Richard R. Ernst]] at [[ETH Zurich]] and also at the [[University of Wisconsin System|University of Wisconsin]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://loop.frontiersin.org/people/124901/bio|title=Annalisa Pastore|website=Loop|language=en|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref>

== Research ==
Pastore started her career at the [[University of Oxford]] as a [[postdoctoral]] [[fellow]] in the Department of Biochemistry, working alongside [[Iain Donald Campbell]].<ref name="CookeWilkinson1987">{{cite journal|last1=Cooke|first1=Robert M.|last2=Wilkinson|first2=Anthony J.|last3=Baron|first3=Martin|last4=Pastore|first4=Annalisa|last5=Tappin|first5=Michael J.|last6=Campbell|first6=Iain D.|last7=Gregory|first7=Harry|last8=Sheard|first8=Brian|title=The solution structure of human epidermal growth factor|journal=Nature|volume=327|issue=6120|year=1987|pages=339–341|issn=0028-0836|doi=10.1038/327339a0|pmid=3495735|bibcode=1987Natur.327..339C|s2cid=4285994}}</ref><ref name=peerj>{{Cite web|url=https://peerj.com/pastore/|title=PeerJ - Profile - Annalisa Pastore|website=peerj.com|language=en|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> Pastore was subsequently appointed a staff scientist position at [[European Molecular Biology Laboratory]] in 1988. In 1991 she was made group leader of the Structures Program.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.embl.es/aboutus/alumni/news/news_2009/mar09_nmr/mar09_nmr-pastore/index.html|title=Alumni News - March 2009 - NMR alumni celebrate opening of NMR centre at EMBL Heidelberg - EMBL|last=EMBL|website=www.embl.es|language=en|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> She joined the [[National Institute for Medical Research]] in 1991. She has solved several structures on the [[Protein Data Bank]]. She was made an honorary professor at [[University College London]].<ref name=membo>{{Cite web|url=https://people.embo.org/profile/annalisa-pastore|title=EMBO MEMBER: Annalisa Pastore|website=people.embo.org|language=en|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> She took a one-year sabbatical at the French National Institute for Agricultural Research.<ref name=":0" /> During this time, she filed several patents related to [[allergen]]s and their uses.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://patents.justia.com/inventor/annalisa-pastore|title=Annalisa Pastore Inventions, Patents and Patent Applications - Justia Patents Search|website=patents.justia.com|language=en|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref>

Pastore worked at [[King's College London]] from 2013 to 2018.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.kcl.ac.uk/ioppn/depts/bcn/dri/lab-groups/annalisa-pastore-group/annalisa-pastore-group.aspx|title=King's College London - Annalisa Pastore Group|website=www.kcl.ac.uk|language=en-GB|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> She has secured several million pounds of funding from [[Medical Research Council (United Kingdom)|Medical Research Council]] and the [[Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://gtr.ukri.org/person/6CBE0257-2178-4A99-8413-14D2620FA769|title=Annalisa Pastore|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> She works on the molecular basis of neurodegeneration.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://kclpure.kcl.ac.uk/portal/annalisa.1.pastore.html|title=Annalisa Pastore - Research Portal, King's College, London|website=kclpure.kcl.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> She looks at diseases caused by protein aggregation, including [[Huntington's disease]] and [[Machado–Joseph disease]].<ref name=":1" /> She also studies pathologies that are a result of misfunctioning of the iron metabolism, including [[Friedreich's ataxia]].<ref name=":1" />  She is interested the structure and function of these diseases and uses a range of characterisation techniques, including AFM, EM and ITC calorimetry.<ref name=":1" /> She served as the Field Chief Editor for [[Frontiers Media]] Molecular Biosciences.<ref>{{Citation|last=Frontiers|title=Frontiers Science Hero Annalisa Pastore|date=2016-02-16|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Bf3p3TO4jA|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> She serves as an editor of ''[[PeerJ]]''.<ref name=peerj/>

In 2018 Pastore was the first woman to be appointed full professor at the faculty of Science of the [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa]].<ref name=superiore>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2018/10/18/pisa-la-prima-prof-ordinaria-in-scienze-nella-storia-della-normale-anche-contro-di-me-offese-sessiste/4702376/|title=Pisa, la prima prof ordinaria di Scienze nella storia della Normale: "Anche contro di me offese sessiste" - Il Fatto Quotidiano|date=2018-10-18|work=Il Fatto Quotidiano|access-date=2018-10-20|language=it-IT}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://27esimaora.corriere.it/18_ottobre_17/sugli-atenei-rettore-ha-ragione-c-ancora-molto-sessismo-1cdc4db4-d24d-11e8-9cd8-6bfe110c11f0.shtml|title=Scuola Normale, Annalisa Pastore è la prima ordinaria di scienze: "Il sessismo? Esiste"|last=Tebano|first=di Elena|work=Corriere della Sera|access-date=2018-10-20|language=it-IT}}</ref>

===Awards and honours===
Pastore was elected a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] (MAE).{{when|date=November 2018}}<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Pastore_Annalisa|title=Academy of Europe: Pastore Annalisa|last=Hoffmann|first=Ilire Hasani, Robert|website=www.ae-info.org|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> She was nominated to AcademiaNet in 2013<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.academia-net.org/profil/prof-annalisa-pastore/1187573|title=Prof. Annalisa Pastore - AcademiaNet|website=www.academia-net.org|language=en|access-date=2018-10-20}}</ref> and made a member of the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO) in 2000.<ref name=membo/>
